content: Customer Vihaan Patel called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to check on his auto policy expiration. Neha confirmed the policy is active until 30/09/2026. Vihaan decided to renew his policy for another 12 months with the current $500 deductible plan using his credit card ending in 1234. Additionally, he requested to add a roadside assistance rider for $5 per month, bringing the total updated premium to $120. Neha processed both requests and confirmed updated policy documents would be emailed.

action_items: Process auto policy renewal for 12 months
Send confirmation email with updated policy documents and total premium details
